description: The project was held on 31st Oct 2026 at Borivali station.The blood donation camp started from 09.00am onwards.Our club President Vimal Joshi himself donated blood at the camp.There were 3 clubs participated in the blood donation drive.The drive was requested by district 3141 as a district event starting from 24 - 31st Oct 2026.
